basis: CN owner-reported displayed-range references, not official specifications. Generation/year applicability is inferred; intervals are not statistical confidence bounds.

vehicles.note: Owner reports around 420–428 km for 2021 SR+. Upper bound conservatively includes the adjacent 60-kWh RWD reference of 439 km because API fields do not identify a production-month/pack transition. This interval is an inference, not an official specification.
Owner-reported 2022 new-car full-charge range. Applied as a generation reference to 2023 with the same classic 18-inch wheel configuration, not to Highland.
First-batch Highland owner report. Reference for the 18-inch RWD generation, not a guaranteed factory value.
2021 owner new-car report, corroborated by 2022 and 2023 owner reports. Reference for classic 19-inch RWD; year extension is a generation-level inference.
Owner reports 521 km at delivery and 528 after BMS capacity settled; another 2023 owner reports about 520 km. Use a reference interval rather than a precise original capacity.

Owner reports 440 km at 80% soon after delivery. 550 km is extrapolated, not a measured full-charge value. Wheel restriction limits use to the standard 18-inch configuration; the owner report does not independently establish wheel size.
Delivery reports and follow-up owner records span 401–435 km across wheel/firmware configurations. This pooled interval is a community reference, not a configuration-exact factory baseline.
2025 owner delivery reports span 520–541 km, including the mid-year battery change. Production month and exact pack are unavailable; use the pooled interval.
